Short title and commencement

ACT XXVII OF 2018
ACT XXVII OF 2018
REGISTRATION (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th May, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(193)/2018/1773, dated 24.5.2018.---The
Registration (Second Amendment) Bill 2018, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on May 16, 2018, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on May 21, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Registration Act, 1908 for purposes
of regulation and supervision of the profession of conveyance writing and to
provide penalty for the persons who engage themselves in conveyance writing
without valid enrolment or license.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Registration (Second
Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 69 of Act XVI of 1908

2. Amendment in
section 69 of Act XVI of 1908.---In the Registration Act,

inserted:

writing;".

Insertion of section 81A in Act XVI of 1908

ACT XXVII OF 2018
ACT XXVII OF 2018
REGISTRATION (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th May, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(193)/2018/1773, dated 24.5.2018.---The
Registration (Second Amendment) Bill 2018, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on May 16, 2018, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on May 21, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Registration Act, 1908 for purposes
of regulation and supervision of the profession of conveyance writing and to
provide penalty for the persons who engage themselves in conveyance writing
without valid enrolment or license.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
3. Insertion of
section 81A in Act XVI of 1908.---In the Act, after section
81, the following new section 81A shall be inserted:
"81A. Penalty for engagement as conveyance writer without
valid enrolment or license.---Whoever engages himself as conveyance
writer without valid enrolment or license shall be punishable with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to three months but which shall not be less than
ten days and with fine which may extend to two hundred thousand rupees but
which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees.".
